heading.wording: Which English test should a nurse take?

questions.wording: Which English test should a nurse take?
OET IELTS se mushkil hai ya aasan? (medical terms ki wajah se phans jaen ge?)
IELTS or OET for Nurses - Which Should You Take?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take?
claims.text: OET builds its tasks from nursing and healthcare workplaces: Listening uses health-related recordings such as nurse and patient consultations, Speaking is a role-play as a nurse with a patient, and Writing is a letter based on case notes. OET's own page for nurses does not say the test is easier or harder than any other test.

heading.wording: How much does the OET Test cost?

questions.wording: How much does the OET Test cost?
OET ki fee Pakistan mein kitni hai? (aik lakh se upar PKR, fail ho gaye to kitna nuqsaan?)

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?
claims.text: OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). The price is published in Australian dollars; the page gives no amount in Pakistani rupees.

heading.wording: Where is the test venue?

questions.wording: Where is the test venue?
When and where is the OET Test available?
Pakistan mein OET ke test centers kahan hain? (Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi ke ilawa bhi?)

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries
claims.text: OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where the Speaking sub-test can be taken at a test venue.

claims.label: SECONDARY
claims.source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan
claims.text: AEO Pakistan's own OET page names venues in Islamabad, Karachi, Lahore and Multan.
claims.statedAs: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan, a secondary source

heading.wording: Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?

questions.wording: Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?
UK NMC ke liye OET mein kitna score chahiye?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: In Australia, for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026, the minimum OET scores are Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360; tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 need B in Listening, Reading and Speaking and C+ in Writing.
claims.statedAs: Ahpra (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency)'s own source

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Ireland's NMBI asks for grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a result less than two years old; it does not accept combined results or OET at home.
claims.statedAs: NMBI (Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland)'s own source

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement
claims.text: The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing, reached within 12 months of the first sitting; it does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre.
claims.statedAs: Nursing Council of New Zealand's own source

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests
claims.text: The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time; the test must be no more than two years old.
claims.statedAs: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK)'s own source

statements.text: Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

questions.wording: Writing task aur referral letter kaisay likhtay hain? (case notes se letter, practice kahan karain?)

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: The Writing sub-test lasts 45 minutes: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. The task is one formal letter for the candidate's own profession, written from case notes, about 180 to 200 words long.

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take?
claims.text: For nurses, OET describes the letter as a referral or discharge letter based on case notes.

statements.text: The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

statements.text: The Writing task is timed at this length in total: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. — 45 minutes

heading.wording: What's in the OET test?

questions.wording: What's in the OET test?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Listening lasts about 40 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions.

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Reading lasts 60 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions in total; Part A materials are collected after 15 minutes.

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Speaking lasts about 20 minutes and has two role-plays for the candidate's own profession, 5 minutes each, with an interlocutor.

statements.text: Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: A full mock has 22 tasks: 10 Listening, 9 Reading, 1 Writing, 2 Speaking; the question count is not given here. — 22 tasks

statements.text: A student can sit a full mock test in the OET order in one sitting, and resume an unfinished one.

heading.wording: What preparation support does OET provide to candidates?

questions.wording: What preparation support does OET provide to candidates?
How much time do you need to prepare for OET?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: OET offers free sample tests for all four sub-tests, as downloads for the paper test and as interactive tests for the computer test. The page does not say how long preparation takes; it suggests a practice test every two to three weeks.

statements.text: All practice material is original and is never copied from OET.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: Practice adapts to the student's level across three difficulty levels.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: The free trial lasts this long. A card is entered at the start and is not charged during the trial. — 7 days
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: The one plan on sale, Pro, is advertised at this price per month. There is no yearly plan and no free plan. — 12 USD
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

heading.wording: OET ka test kaise book karte hain?

questions.wording: OET ka test kaise book karte hain?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home.

heading.wording: Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

questions.wording: Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date?
claims.text: Moving a booking to another date costs AU$120 before bookings close for that test date and AU$200 after. A paper test can be moved up to the day before the test; a computer or at-home test up to two days before the first sub-test.

heading.wording: OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

questions.wording: OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests.

heading.wording: OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

questions.wording: OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted.

heading.wording: Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

questions.wording: Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?
claims.text: After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515.

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests
claims.text: The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it.
claims.statedAs: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK)'s own source

heading.wording: Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

questions.wording: Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book.

heading.wording: Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

questions.wording: Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession.

statements.text: Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

heading.wording: How is the Speaking sub-test assessed?

questions.wording: How is the Speaking sub-test assessed?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and has two role-plays set in the candidate's own profession, each 5 minutes long, with an interlocutor. It is recorded, and two OET assessors mark it on linguistic criteria and clinical communication criteria.

statements.text: The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: Speaking is judged from a transcript of what the student said, not from accent or audio quality.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: Each Speaking role-play lasts this long. — 5 minutes
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

heading.wording: How is the Writing sub-test marked?

questions.wording: How is the Writing sub-test marked?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria.

heading.wording: Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

questions.wording: Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home.
claims.statedAs: HCPC (Health and Care Professions Council, UK)'s own source

heading.wording: What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

questions.wording: What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements
claims.text: Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting.

statements.text: Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

heading.wording: What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

questions.wording: What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home.

heading.wording: Where can I find OET speech pathology practice materials?

questions.wording: Where can I find OET speech pathology practice materials?

claims.source: OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer)
claims.text: OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card.

claims.source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?
claims.text: OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA).

heading.wording: How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

questions.wording: How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home.

heading.wording: How long do OET results take?

questions.wording: How long do OET results take?

claims.text: OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book.

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific? · How is the Speaking sub-test assessed? · How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — The OET Test · read 2026-10-12

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions. THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

How is the Speaking sub-test assessed? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and has two role-plays set in the candidate's own profession, each 5 minutes long, with an interlocutor. It is recorded, and two OET assessors mark it on linguistic criteria and clinical communication criteria. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Speaking sub-test · read 2026-10-12

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria. THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

Speaking is judged from a transcript of what the student said, not from accent or audio quality. THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

Each Speaking role-play lasts this long. — 5 minutes THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

How is the Writing sub-test marked? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Writing sub-test · read 2026-10-12

Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. RESPONSIBLE BODY · HCPC — English language proficiency · read 2026-10-12

What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting. RESPONSIBLE BODY · Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · read 2026-10-12

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given. THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. RESPONSIBLE BODY · CORU — Language requirements · read 2026-10-12

Where can I find OET speech pathology practice materials? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer) · read 2026-10-12

How much does the OET cost? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · read 2026-10-12

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Book a test · read 2026-10-12

How long do OET results take? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Results and scoring · read 2026-10-12

For how long are OET Test results valid? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Results and scoring · read 2026-10-12

What ID do I need on OET test day? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Test regulations · read 2026-10-12
